front.title: Ordering of RRSets in CNAME Responses in the DNS

abstract.t: In the DNS, recursive resolvers receive queries and formulate corresponding responses by reference to data obtained from authoritative servers. In the case where the query name (QNAME) and class (QCLASS) in the query matches an owner name in the DNS where a canonical name (CNAME) resource record is published, the response includes both the CNAME record and the resource record set corresponding to the request's query type (QTYPE) published at the CNAME target. The ordering of these two different RRSets has not previously been clearly specified, but operational experience based on real-world client implementations confirms that the order is important. This document updates RFC 1034 1035 to provide a clearer specification, consistent with deployed implementations.
